engine: analytic convex solids + separating-axis test (numpy, scipy.spatial.ConvexHull); NOT mesh-based
trimesh_manifold3d: not installed; Blender not available here

excluded_pairs.arm / rod Z-bend pin: pin seated in the arm hole (ctx.seat / E-MEC rod Z-bend in the arm tip hole; hole not subtracted)
excluded_pairs.horn rib / elevon slab: rib bonded in its slot through the elevon (E-MEC horn edge, D-212 rev 3; slot cut in the CAD elevon)
excluded_pairs.horn blade / elevon slab: blade base on the elevon skin over the slot
excluded_pairs.clevis pin / horn rib: pin and horn are one rigid group; pin sits about 9.5 mm above the skin
excluded_pairs.keeper spacer / arm: keeper clamped on the arm top by the arm screw (E-MEC keeper edge)
excluded_pairs.keeper bridge / arm: keeper clamped on the arm top (same rigid group)
excluded_pairs.clevis pin / elevon slab: pin is part of the elevon-side group (rigid with the slab)
excluded_pairs.elevon slab / core aft block: hull artifact: the convex hull of the elevon section fills the cove that the hull of the core aft block also fills; the elevon-core pair is checked on the non-convex 2-D sections instead
excluded_pairs.horn rib / core aft block: hull artifact as for the elevon slab: the rib lies inside the elevon section; checked on the non-convex 2-D section (rib outline vs core) instead

design_contacts.arm / servo case: arm bottom sits on the case top (ARM_Z0 = SV_Z1, boss height "-")
design_contacts.rod / arm: ELEVON_ZJ=lo: the rod rests on the arm top at the low end of the Z-bend freedom (rod bottom tangent, by design); mid and hi leave a gap
design_contacts.rod / keeper bridge: ELEVON_ZJ=hi: the rod top bears on the keeper bridge at the high end of the Z-bend freedom (by design, D-212 rev 3); mid and lo leave a gap

elevon_vs_core_2d.note: elevon nose touches the core corner at the hinge at neutral by construction (0 mm); sections only (no balance pocket, caps, tape)
